gloss: to push through; to persist in; to force one's way

definitions.gloss: to push through; to persist in; to insist on
definitions.explanation: To carry something through to the end despite opposition or difficulty, especially one's opinion, will, or way of doing things.

definitions.gloss: to force one's way through; to push through physically
definitions.explanation: To physically push through a barrier, crowd, or obstacle.

examples.english: He tried to force his way past security and into the venue.

notes:
A compound godan verb (⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧ + ⟦{通|とお}す→通す：02300_toosu⟧) meaning to push something all the way through. The figurative sense of persisting stubbornly is more common than the physical sense.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}し{通|とお}す: to push through one's opinion
- ⟦{主張|しゅちょう}→主張：03220_shuchou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}し{通|とお}す: to insist on one's claim
- ⟦{我|わ}→我：28333_wa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}し{通|とお}す: to insist on having one's way
- ⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}し{通|とお}す: to force something unreasonable through

USAGE:
Often carries a negative nuance of stubbornness or forceful behavior, though it can also convey admirable determination depending on context.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{押|お}し{切|き}る→押し切る：06793_oshikiru⟧: to override, to push past — emphasizes overcoming resistance at a specific point
- ⟦{貫|つらぬ}く→貫く：18728_tsuranuku⟧: to carry through, to stick to — more literary; emphasizes unwavering commitment to principles
- ⟦{通|とお}す→通す：02300_toosu⟧: to let through, to carry through — broader meaning; {押|お}し{通|とお}す adds the forceful element
